cache_scope: experimental unit plus complete provider body; execution cohort/model-identity gate required
cross_unit_deduplication: not applied; retain Phase 3C experimental-unit cache policy (317 unique bodies, 326 case/arm requests); duplicate prompts do not establish independent biological observations
numerical_drift_policy: retain actual recomputed ranks/scores in both arms; no historical value substitution or tolerance-based cache equivalence

prices.source_note: Official API pricing fetched using OpenAI Docs. Public Standard short-context rates; no assumption of account access or cache discounts. requested_decision: separate authorization for 326 validation calls across matched clean/degraded arms, one attempt each, USD 30 ceiling; no held-out evaluation
temporal_drift_limit: identical request bodies are necessary, not sufficient, for compatible hosted behavior; run paired arms interleaved in one cohort, record returned model/SDK/endpoint and pause for identity drift; historical response times differ
